parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which you want to create the instance.

parameters.name: ResourceIds
parameters.description: The list of resource IDs. Valid values of N: 1 to 1.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Valid values:

*   cluster: cluster

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type cluster --resource-ids c-b933c5aac8fe0000 --tags example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1 'example-string' --ResourceIds.1 'c-b933c5aac8fe0000' --ResourceType cluster --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
